title: Code, data and supplemental materials for: HEC-18 Pier Scour against Field Data: Measured versus Maximum Scour and Bridge-Level Bounds
description: Reproducible code, the flagged USGS Pier-Scour Database (PSDb-2014) tables, all result tables, figures and the Supplemental Materials (Supplemental_Materials.pdf: Sections S1-S8, Tables S1-S26, Fig. S1) for the manuscript submitted to the Journal of Hydraulic Engineering (ASCE). Code is released under the MIT licence; derived data under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA.md). The original PSDb-2014 is a U.S. Geological Survey public-domain dataset (Benedict and Caldwell 2014, Data Series 845, https://doi.org/10.3133/ds845).
